purpose: Refresh remaining gaps after hard-gap-only search through MM-DATA-171. Publicly searchable mechanism evidence and actually rights-clear/reusable raw data remain separate concepts.

gaps.gap: rights-cleared shot -> action -> verified recovery raw histories
gaps.target: chronological cycle ID, pre-action process state, physical defect/quality, actual process adjustment, post-action traces and verified recovery
gaps.why: Wave 11 found unusually strong recovery experiments, but their reusable cycle tables have not yet been released.

gaps.target: actual MouldMaster learner responses and longitudinal learning outcomes
gaps.why: Not searched in wave 11 because public proxy data cannot close this gap.

gaps.target: three or more blinded injection-moulding engineers per diagnostic case
gaps.why: Not searched in wave 11 because only real MouldMaster-specific review can close this gap.

gaps.gap: rights-clear multi-machine / multi-mould labeled raw corpus
gaps.target: source/target machine and mould identities, cycle order, process actuals, physical quality and actual fault/cause labels
gaps.why: Multiple excellent industrial cross-machine families now exist, but most underlying tables remain confidential or request-only.

gaps.gap: maintenance intervention -> quantified recovery raw histories
gaps.target: natural degradation/fouling, maintenance trigger, exact repair/cleaning action, post-maintenance signal and quality recovery
gaps.why: Cooling-cleaning field evidence now supplies before/after recovery examples, but natural machine/tool wear with detailed repair-to-recovery cycle data remains scarce.

gaps.target: actual zone temperature, heater current/output or energy, thermocouples, valve-pin command/actual, alarms, nozzle/manifold state, cavity pressure and quality per shot
gaps.why: Wave 11 added separate hot-runner-controller energy and valve-gate pressure, but not a rights-clear row-level device-state dataset.

gaps.gap: longitudinal cooling fouling -> cleaning -> recovery raw data
gaps.target: weeks/months of flow, delta-T, pressure drop, water condition and quality before fouling, through cleaning, and after recovery
gaps.why: Two independent quantified cleaning/recovery cases were found, so the remaining need is longitudinal machine-readable history rather than another cleaning case study.

gaps.gap: rights-clear multicavity shot-level physical outcome data
gaps.target: per-shot/per-cavity pressure, temperature, weight, dimensions, defects and runner/gate state
gaps.why: The experimental evidence is already broad; machine-readable cavity-by-cavity author data would now add more value than further papers.

gaps.gap: deterministic admission of executable public candidates
gaps.target: retrieve/hash/profile/rights-review OpenMMS, EPP, PASCOE/imPURE, RWTH PCR, FORinFPRO and other confirmed executable records
gaps.why: These are already discovered; further search has lower value than admission engineering.

gaps.gap: production material-lot / conditioning linked to cycle outcomes
gaps.target: supplier, exact grade, lot/COA, moisture/drying/regrind state and rheology tied to production cycle IDs and quality
gaps.why: Wave 11 added a six-consecutive-batch PCR-HDPE family and another explicit recyclate batch-change/recovery case; what remains is routine plant traceability.

gaps.target: component-specific actuals, interface/core position, tool temperature/pressure, sequence and physical bond/dimensional outcome
gaps.why: Wave 11 identified explicit author-data routes for sensor-monitored overmoulding and two additional interface/quality studies; permission and delivery are now the bottleneck.

gaps.gap: rights-clear measured assessments with real psychometrics
gaps.target: questions derived from admitted raw evidence and calibrated using actual MouldMaster learners
gaps.why: No additional generic question datasets were searched because this gap requires app-specific learner evidence.

wave11SearchBoundary: No simulation-only sources unless tied to a missing measured raw route
No duplicate same-experiment papers counted as independent evidence
